basis.source: Repository canonical dimension and renderer fixture families plus Phase E.6 synthetic canonical fixtures.
limitations: No real production population corpus was available.
Stats describe deterministic repository fixtures, not user-population rates.
The first Phase E.6 slice made named-family gates stricter before this second-slice baseline.

dimensionsMostOftenResponsibleForBlends.reason: central score near adjacent state targets
state targets overlap around stable mid-high values
missing demand requirements reduce candidate margins
restraint targets overlap without interactional evidence

provenCauses: Insufficient named-family support now correctly creates unresolved dimensions.
Some state regions overlap around center-to-mid-high coordinates.
Candidate eligibility penalizes missing requirements but still allows near ties.
Compatibility margins are small when dimensions cluster near 0.5.

thresholdChanges.after: boundary blend when top-two margin <= 0.06 and top two candidates remain adjacent within the same constellation
thresholdChanges.reason: Fixture review showed margins between 0.06 and 0.08 were often weak-confidence overlap rather than meaningful adjacent ambiguity.

preservedBehavior: Unresolved results remain unresolved when coverage or confidence fails.
No winner is forced when evidence is insufficient.
Adjacent ambiguity remains representable through deterministic composites.
